name: Incendiary Arrow
description:
Once per day per rank you have in Craft: The next time you fire a projectile weapon this turn, halve the range of the weapon for the shot, and the projectile carries fire with it.

If the projectile hits a creature, it deals an additional 1d4 damage. If the projectile hits a flammable object, it sets fire to the object.

Describe how you prepare and fire the arrow.
